data.title: 中野三玖 · 战国书卷畔的耳机羞语
data.action: 抱着大抱枕把脸埋进半截，脖子上挂着大耳机，蓝绿发丝垂落在露出的洁白香肩上，暗蓝眼眸偷偷抬起看你。
data.location: 榻榻米地板上铺着软垫，四周散落着武田信玄与战国武将的历史图鉴
data.lighting: 桌面小阅读灯在书页与发丝上投下一圈温暖的橘黄光晕，其余环境柔和沉静
data.mood: 内向三妹的无声告白，温柔、克制而满怀深情
data.description: 榻榻米地板上铺着软垫，四周散落着武田信玄与战国武将的历史图鉴。抱着大抱枕把脸埋进半截，脖子上挂着大耳机，蓝绿发丝垂落在露出的洁白香肩上，暗蓝眼眸偷偷抬起看你。 她微微抬眸轻语——“风太郎……今天我烤的抹茶饼干，有比上次稍微好吃一点点吗？……如果合格的话，就奖励你再多陪我一会儿。”
data.promptProse: Seated on a tatami cushion surrounded by open samurai history books at night, Miku Nakano wears a soft mist-blue cable-knit halter camisole slip leaving her shoulders bare beneath her neck-hung headphones. Pressing a large bolster pillow up to hide her lower face, she peers shyly upward in the warm orange glow of a small reading lamp.
data.animaCaption: Seated on a tatami floor cushion amidst open Sengoku history books in a soft mist-blue cable-knit halter slip, she buries her lower face behind a large bolster pillow and peeks shyly up at the viewer. A small reading lamp casts a warm amber circle across the pages and her bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a soft mist-blue cable-knit halter camisole slip dress with bare open shoulders and a relaxed ribbed hem.
